verdict.meaning: The new version generates code at runtime from a base64-encoded string that reads process.env and exfiltrates environment variables to an undocumented domain (telemetry-edge.pages.dev) under the guise of telemetry.
verdict.note: Obfuscated runtime code generation sending environment variables to an unknown destination is the hallmark of credential exfiltration.

second.meaning: The package dynamically builds a function that fetches a URL incorporating an environment variable and sends it to telemetry-edge.pages.dev.

judgement.reason: two models, independently, read this as a payload that was not in the source, reaching the network
